items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde las primeras competencias oficiales en Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad. Desde entonces, el cubo ha unido a personas de todas las edades y rincones del país, creciendo hasta convertirse en la gran comunidad que tenemos hoy.
La inscripción está abierta para todas las personas, sin importar edad ni lugar de origen. ¡Ven y sé parte de este evento histórico que marcará un antes y un después en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
This year we proudly celebrate the tenth anniversary since the first official competitions in Bolivia, which marked the beginning of our community. Since then, the cube has united people of all ages and from every corner of the country, growing into the great community we have today.
Registration is open to everyone, regardless of age or origin. Be part of this historic event that will mark a before and after in Bolivia!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ5MjM2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fd2d5430e0e65dca6b65cbf38dcd107612d4d4a2/MYHM%20Banner.png)

🇧🇷 **Português:**
A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento.

Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador.

Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

🇺🇸 **English:**
The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation.

To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler.

By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

El Speedcubing regresa a la Región del Biobío con Los Ángeles Chile Back 2025, la segunda competencia oficial WCA del año en la ciudad.

Después del gran éxito de Los Ángeles Comeback 2025, esta nueva edición busca seguir impulsando el desarrollo del cubo Rubik en el sur de Chile, reuniendo a competidores nuevos y experimentados en una jornada llena de desafíos, compañerismo y diversión. No te lo pierdas!!

**English** 

Speedcubing returns to the Biobío Region with Los Ángeles Chile Back 2025, the second official WCA competition of the year in the city.

After the great success of Los Ángeles Comeback 2025, this new edition aims to further promote the development of the Rubik's Cube in southern Chile, bringing together new and experienced competitors for a day full of challenges, camaraderie, and fun. Don't miss it!!

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67008-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

### Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition
Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**.  If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67007-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab.  Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers.  Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap.  You can still register to compete in both events;  you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.  

### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each.  This is due to venue space and limited seating available.
